fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (WMT) surged +175% over the past five years, significantly outperforming Amazon (+49.7%) and Target (-27.8%), but momentum has slowed this year while maintaining a premium valuation at forward P/E of 40.1x.
fields.summary_ko.1: If Q3 results announced on November 19 reveal weak guidance that cannot overcome external headwinds (rising oil prices), further stock adjustment is possible, though relative advantages persist through value-oriented positioning and market share expansion in higher-income segments.
